Questionnaire content license
=============================

Upstream: https://github.com/openjung/core
Fixed revision: 4d7917df1857e2dc04adc47fab3ecc0c8db10612

The OEJTS questionnaire items and every adaptation of them, including the
English prompts, the left/right trait wording, the quick-test subset and all
44 locales in src/questions.ts and src/questionTranslations.ts, are derived
from the Open Extended Jungian Type Scales 1.2 by Eric Jorgenson /
Open Psychometrics and are licensed under

    Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International
    https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/

Source: https://openpsychometrics.org/tests/OJTS/development/OEJTS1.2.pdf

The MIT license on the upstream code does not override the attribution,
noncommercial and share-alike terms that apply to this content. If you ship
the questions, keep the attribution and these terms. See upstream
TRANSLATIONS.md for provenance and the review status of each locale.

This project includes the 32 English/Chinese question records and an adapted
Chinese display/graph dataset for NONCOMMERCIAL GRADUATION DEMONSTRATION.
These adapted content files are also offered under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
No endorsement or independent validation of this project is implied.
